specification.objective: Keep the active-page badge in the mobile workspace header anchored to the right edge, allowing its width to grow only to the left and truncating its label when space is limited.

requirements.statement: The active-page badge remains right-aligned at a fixed inset from the mobile header's right edge regardless of label or viewport width.
The badge uses only available horizontal space to its left; its text stays on one line and truncates with an ellipsis when the available width is insufficient.
The mobile menu/brand remains in its current left-side position and does not overlap or get displaced by the active-page badge.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Widget regressions at wide and narrow mobile widths assert the badge right edge stays at the header's fixed right inset and the row has no layout exception.
A narrow-width widget regression verifies the page label is single-line and configured to ellipsize rather than overflow or shift the badge.
The focused workspace-shell widget tests pass after the layout correction.

invariants.statement: Do not alter desktop navigation, routes, active destination selection, or the mobile menu behavior.
The active-page badge remains accessible with its full destination label in semantics even when its visible text is truncated.

forbidden_states.statement: The active-page badge drifts toward the center/left as the viewport narrows or as its label changes.
The badge text wraps, overflows the header, overlaps the menu/brand, or is clipped without an ellipsis.

inputs.statement: Current mobile workspace route and its destination label.
Available viewport width in the mobile layout.

outputs.statement: A right-anchored active-page badge whose label fits or truncates safely.

failure_semantics.statement: The regression test exits nonzero and prints mobile_page_badge_regression_missing when the right anchor, truncation, or no-overlap contract fails.

argv: mobile page badge stays pinned right and truncates when narrow
mobile page badge stays pinned right and truncates when narrow
